target.title: fix(msteams): strip internal tool-trace banners from outbound text
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Microsoft Teams outbound adapters (channel.ts and outbound.ts) did not strip
internal tool-trace banners from assistant-visible text before delivery. Users
could see internal scaffolding like `⚠️ 🛠️ search repos (agent) failed` in
their Teams messages.

## Why This Change Was Made

Added `sanitizeAssistantVisibleText` (the canonical shared sanitizer) to both
outbound adapters via the `sanitizeText` hook. This matches the fix already
applied to tlon (#103450) and synology-chat (#102925).

## User Impact

**Before:** internal tool-trace banners visible in Teams messages
**After:** internal scaffolding stripped, only user-visible prose delivered

## Evidence

Branch: `fix/msteams-sanitize-outbound` | Base: `upstream/main`

### Regression tests

```
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/msteams/src/channel.test.ts --reporter=verbose
Tests  18 passed (18)
```

### Diff summary

```
extensions/msteams/src/channel.ts       | 4 ++ (import + sanitizeText hook)
extensions/msteams/src/outbound.ts      | 4 ++ (import + sanitizeText hook)
extensions/msteams/src/channel.test.ts  | 12 ++ (2 regression tests)
```

- [x] I understand what the code does
- [x] Change is focused and does not mix unrelated concerns
